point_two.text: Not every fruit or vegetable belongs in a crisper drawer. Iowa State University Extension says tomatoes and bananas are better kept at room temperature, such as on a counter. Potatoes, sweet potatoes, onions, and garlic do not need refrigeration, either. They prefer a cool, dry spot instead — that is not always the same as a warm kitchen counter.

in_one_line.text: Give leafy greens a closed, humid space, and give ethylene-releasing fruit like apples an open path for its gas. The right drawer can mean less wilting, slower spoilage, and produce that stays useful for longer.
